```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css"/>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/papaparse@5.4.1/papaparse.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>

<style>
  .reg-hero{background:var(--map-navy,#0f172a);color:#fff;padding:2.5rem 2rem;}
  .reg-hero h1{font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Condensed',sans-serif;font-size:2.2rem;margin:0 0 .4rem;}
  .reg-hero p{opacity:.75;margin:0;font-size:1rem;}
  .reg-wrap{max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;padding:1.5rem 1.5rem 3rem;}

  /* Controls bar */
  .reg-controls{display:flex;gap:.75rem;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:end;padding:1.25rem;background:#fff;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid var(--map-border,#e2e8f0);box-shadow:var(--map-shadow);margin-bottom:1rem;}
  .reg-controls .ctrl{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.3rem;}
  .reg-controls label{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--map-text-muted,#64748b);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em;}
  .reg-controls select,.reg-controls input[type=search]{padding:.55rem .75rem;border:1px solid var(--map-border,#e2e8f0);border-radius:4px;font-size:.9rem;min-width:170px;background:#fff;}
  .reg-controls select:focus,.reg-controls input[type=search]:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--map-red,#0d9488);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(13,148,136,.1);}

  /* Boundary-level pill row */
  .reg-viewbar{display:flex;gap:.4rem;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-bottom:.75rem;font-size:.85rem;}
  .reg-viewbar .lbl{color:var(--map-text-muted,#64748b);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;font-size:.72rem;margin-right:.35rem;}
  .reg-viewpill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.35rem;padding:.45rem .95rem;border-radius:4px;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;background:#f1f5f9;color:var(--map-text-muted,#64748b);border:none;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;}
  .reg-viewpill.active{background:var(--map-red,#0d9488);color:#fff;}
  .reg-viewpill:not(.active):hover{background:#e2e8f0;}

  #reg-map{width:100%;height:600px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid var(--map-border,#e2e8f0);box-shadow:var(--map-shadow);z-index:1;}

  .reg-status{padding:.75rem 1rem;border-radius:4px;font-size:.88rem;margin-bottom:1rem;background:rgba(13,148,136,.05);border-left:4px solid var(--map-red,#0d9488);}
  .reg-summary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(140px,1fr));gap:.75rem;margin:1rem 0;}
  .reg-scard{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--map-border,#e2e8f0);border-radius:4px;padding:1rem;text-align:center;box-shadow:var(--map-shadow);}
  .reg-scard .val{font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Condensed',sans-serif;font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--map-red,#0d9488);}
  .reg-scard .lbl{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--map-text-muted,#64748b);margin-top:.2rem;}

  /* Legend */
  .info.legend{background:#fff;padding:.6rem .8rem;border-radius:4px;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(15,23,42,.15);font-size:.78rem;line-height:1.4;color:#0f172a;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;max-width:200px;}
  .info.legend .lg-title{font-weight:700;font-size:.75rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#64748b;margin-bottom:.35rem;}
  .info.legend .lg-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;margin:2px 0;}
  .info.legend i{display:inline-block;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:2px;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08);}

  /* Hover panel */
  .info.hover-panel{background:rgba(255,255,255,.95);padding:.55rem .75rem;border-radius:4px;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(15,23,42,.15);font-size:.82rem;color:#0f172a;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;min-width:180px;}
  .info.hover-panel .h-name{font-weight:700;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Condensed',sans-serif;color:#0f172a;}
  .info.hover-panel .h-parent{color:#64748b;font-size:.75rem;margin-top:1px;}
  .info.hover-panel .h-count{margin-top:.35rem;color:var(--map-red,#0d9488);font-weight:700;font-size:1.1rem;}

  /* Table */
  .reg-table-wrap{margin-top:1.5rem;}
  .reg-table-container{max-height:440px;overflow:auto;border:1px solid var(--map-border,#e2e8f0);border-radius:4px;}
  #reg-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.85rem;}
  #reg-table thead{background:var(--map-navy,#0f172a);color:#fff;position:sticky;top:0;}
  #reg-table th{padding:.65rem .75rem;text-align:left;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;white-space:nowrap;}
  #reg-table th:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);}
  #reg-table td{padding:.55rem .75rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--map-border,#e2e8f0);}
  #reg-table tbody tr:hover{background:rgba(13,148,136,.03);}

  .dl-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;padding:.55rem 1rem;background:var(--map-red,#0d9488);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:4px;font-size:.85rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;}
  .dl-btn:hover{background:#0f766e;color:#fff;}

  .gi-section{margin-top:2rem;padding-top:1.5rem;border-top:1px solid var(--map-border,#e2e8f0);}
  .gi-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1.25rem;}
  .gi-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--map-border,#e2e8f0);border-radius:4px;padding:1.25rem;box-shadow:var(--map-shadow);}
  .gi-card h3{font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Condensed',sans-serif;font-size:1rem;margin:0 0 .75rem;color:var(--map-navy,#0f172a);}
  .gi-card canvas{max-height:300px !important;}
  @media(max-width:768px){#reg-map{height:400px;} .gi-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
</style>

<section class="reg-hero">
  <div style="max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;">
    <h1>CPP Registry Explorer</h1>
    <p>Every Community Pharmaceutical Premise in the Pharmacy Council of Tanzania inventory &mdash; searchable, filterable, and mapped as points or admin-boundary choropleths.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="reg-wrap">

  <div class="reg-status" id="reg-status">Loading CPP registry…</div>

  <div class="reg-summary" id="reg-summary"></div>

  <div class="reg-viewbar">
    <span class="lbl">Map view</span>
    <button class="reg-viewpill active" data-view="regions">Regions</button>
    <button class="reg-viewpill" data-view="districts">Districts</button>
    <button class="reg-viewpill" data-view="wards">Wards</button>
    <span style="flex:1"></span>
    <span id="reg-view-note" style="color:#64748b;font-size:.75rem;"></span>
  </div>

  <div class="reg-controls">
    <div class="ctrl">
      <label for="f-region">Region</label>
      <select id="f-region"><option value="">All regions</option></select>
    </div>
    <div class="ctrl">
      <label for="f-district">District</label>
      <select id="f-district" disabled><option value="">All districts</option></select>
    </div>
    <div class="ctrl">
      <label for="f-ward">Ward</label>
      <select id="f-ward" disabled><option value="">All wards</option></select>
    </div>
    <div class="ctrl">
      <label for="f-biz">Business type</label>
      <select id="f-biz"><option value="">All types</option></select>
    </div>
    <div class="ctrl">
      <label for="f-acc">Accreditation</label>
      <select id="f-acc"><option value="">All sources</option></select>
    </div>
    <div class="ctrl">
      <label for="f-search">Search</label>
      <input type="search" id="f-search" placeholder="Outlet, ward, street…"/>
    </div>
    <div class="ctrl" style="flex:1;text-align:right;">
      <a class="dl-btn" href="data/tanzania/addo_standardized.csv" download>
        <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/><polyline points="7 10 12 15 17 10"/><line x1="12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="3"/></svg>
        Download CSV
      </a>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="reg-map"></div>

  <div class="reg-table-wrap">
    <div class="reg-table-container">
      <table id="reg-table">
        <thead><tr>
          <th data-k="addo_name">Outlet</th>
          <th data-k="business_type">Type</th>
          <th data-k="accreditation_source">Accreditation</th>
          <th data-k="region">Region</th>
          <th data-k="district">District</th>
          <th data-k="ward">Ward</th>
          <th data-k="has_coords">Geocoded</th>
        </tr></thead>
        <tbody></tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="gi-section">
    <h2 style="font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Condensed',sans-serif;font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--map-navy,#0f172a);margin:0 0 1rem;">Coverage snapshot</h2>
    <div class="gi-grid">
      <div class="gi-card">
        <h3>Outlets per region (top 15)</h3>
        <canvas id="chart-region"></canvas>
      </div>
      <div class="gi-card">
        <h3>Accreditation source</h3>
        <canvas id="chart-acc"></canvas>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>

<script>
(function () {
  // ── Endpoints ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const CSV_URL  = "data/tanzania/addo_standardized.csv";
  const GEO_URLS = {
    regions:   "data/tanzania/boundaries/tza_regions.geojson",
    districts: "data/tanzania/boundaries/tza_districts.geojson",
    wards:     "data/tanzania/boundaries/tza_wards.geojson",
  };
  const GID_COL = { regions: "gid_region", districts: "gid_district", wards: "gid_ward" };

  const els = {
    status: document.getElementById("reg-status"),
    summary: document.getElementById("reg-summary"),
    fRegion: document.getElementById("f-region"),
    fDistrict: document.getElementById("f-district"),
    fWard: document.getElementById("f-ward"),
    fBiz: document.getElementById("f-biz"),
    fAcc: document.getElementById("f-acc"),
    fSearch: document.getElementById("f-search"),
    tbody: document.querySelector("#reg-table tbody"),
    viewNote: document.getElementById("reg-view-note"),
    viewPills: document.querySelectorAll(".reg-viewpill"),
  };

  // ── Map + basemap ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const map = L.map("reg-map", { preferCanvas: true }).setView([-6.4, 35.0], 6);
  L.tileLayer("https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png",
    { attribution: "&copy; OpenStreetMap &copy; CARTO", maxZoom: 19 }).addTo(map);

  let polyLayer = null;   // Leaflet GeoJSON layer for the active polygon view
  let currentView = "regions";
  const geoCache = {};    // level -> parsed GeoJSON

  // Sequential teal ramp (Colorbrewer YlGnBu variant biased toward teals)
  const RAMP = ["#f1f5f9", "#ccfbf1", "#5eead4", "#14b8a6", "#0d9488", "#0f766e", "#134e4a"];

  // Legend + hover control (Leaflet controls, bottom-right / top-right)
  const legendCtl = L.control({ position: "bottomright" });
  legendCtl.onAdd = function () {
    this._div = L.DomUtil.create("div", "info legend");
    return this._div;
  };
  legendCtl.update = function (breaks, unit) {
    if (!breaks) { this._div.innerHTML = ""; return; }
    let html = `<div class="lg-title">${unit} · CPPs</div>`;
    for (let i = 0; i < breaks.length - 1; i++) {
      html += `<div class="lg-row"><i style="background:${RAMP[i + 1]}"></i>${breaks[i].toLocaleString()}${i === breaks.length - 2 ? "+" : "&ndash;" + (breaks[i + 1] - 1).toLocaleString()}</div>`;
    }
    html += `<div class="lg-row"><i style="background:${RAMP[0]}"></i>0</div>`;
    this._div.innerHTML = html;
  };

  const hoverCtl = L.control({ position: "topright" });
  hoverCtl.onAdd = function () {
    this._div = L.DomUtil.create("div", "info hover-panel");
    this._div.innerHTML = '<em style="color:#94a3b8;">Hover a polygon</em>';
    return this._div;
  };
  hoverCtl.update = function (props) {
    if (!props) { this._div.innerHTML = '<em style="color:#94a3b8;">Hover a polygon</em>'; return; }
    const parent = [props.district, props.region].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
    this._div.innerHTML =
      `<div class="h-name">${escapeHtml(props.name || "—")}</div>` +
      (parent ? `<div class="h-parent">${escapeHtml(parent)}</div>` : "") +
      `<div class="h-count">${(props.addo_count || 0).toLocaleString()} <span style="font-weight:400;color:#64748b;font-size:.75rem;">ADDOs</span></div>`;
  };

  // ── State ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  let all = [];
  let currentRows = [];
  let sortState = { key: "addo_name", dir: 1 };
  const regionChart = { instance: null };
  const accChart    = { instance: null };

  // ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const fmt = (v) => (v === null || v === undefined || v === "" ? "&mdash;" : String(v));
  const cmp = (a, b) => (a == null ? 1 : b == null ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : a < b ? -1 : 0);
  const uniq = (rows, k) => [...new Set(rows.map((r) => r[k]).filter((v) => v !== null && v !== ""))].sort();
  function escapeHtml(s) { return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c])); }

  // Compute quantile-ish breakpoints for the choropleth ramp given raw counts.
  function computeBreaks(values) {
    const nz = values.filter(v => v > 0).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    if (nz.length === 0) return [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6];
    const q = (p) => nz[Math.min(nz.length - 1, Math.floor(p * nz.length))];
    const raw = [1, q(0.20), q(0.40), q(0.60), q(0.80), q(0.95)];
    // dedupe + ensure monotonic
    const out = [];
    for (const v of raw) { if (!out.length || v > out[out.length - 1]) out.push(v); }
    while (out.length < 6) out.push((out[out.length - 1] || 0) + 1);
    out.push(Infinity);
    return out;  // length 7 → 6 filled bins
  }
  function colorFor(count, breaks) {
    if (count <= 0) return RAMP[0];
    for (let i = 0; i < breaks.length - 1; i++) {
      if (count >= breaks[i] && count < breaks[i + 1]) return RAMP[i + 1];
    }
    return RAMP[RAMP.length - 1];
  }

  // ── Data load ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Papa.parse(CSV_URL, {
    download: true, header: true, skipEmptyLines: true, dynamicTyping: false,
    complete: (res) => {
      all = res.data.map((r) => ({
        ...r,
        latitude: r.latitude ? parseFloat(r.latitude) : null,
        longitude: r.longitude ? parseFloat(r.longitude) : null,
        has_coords: r.has_coords === "True" || r.has_coords === "true",
        gid_region: r.gid_region || null,
        gid_district: r.gid_district || null,
        gid_ward: r.gid_ward || null,
      }));
      populateFilters();
      applyFilters();
      els.status.innerHTML =
        `Loaded <strong>${all.length.toLocaleString()}</strong> outlets. ` +
        `Toggle <em>Regions</em> / <em>Districts</em> / <em>Wards</em> above to switch the map to a choropleth of CPP counts per polygon.`;
    },
    error: (err) => {
      els.status.textContent = "Failed to load registry: " + err.message;
      els.status.style.borderLeftColor = "#dc2626";
    },
  });

  // ── Filter controls ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  function populateFilters() {
    for (const v of uniq(all, "region")) els.fRegion.add(new Option(v, v));
    for (const v of uniq(all, "business_type")) els.fBiz.add(new Option(v, v));
    for (const v of uniq(all, "accreditation_source")) els.fAcc.add(new Option(v, v));

    els.fRegion.addEventListener("input", () => {
      rebuildChildSelect(els.fDistrict, "district", (r) => !els.fRegion.value || r.region === els.fRegion.value);
      els.fWard.innerHTML = '<option value="">All wards</option>';
      els.fWard.disabled = true;
      applyFilters();
    });
    els.fDistrict.addEventListener("input", () => {
      rebuildChildSelect(els.fWard, "ward", (r) =>
        (!els.fRegion.value   || r.region === els.fRegion.value) &&
        (!els.fDistrict.value || r.district === els.fDistrict.value));
      applyFilters();
    });
    [els.fWard, els.fBiz, els.fAcc, els.fSearch].forEach((el) =>
      el.addEventListener("input", applyFilters)
    );

    els.viewPills.forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener("click", () => setView(btn.dataset.view)));

    document.querySelectorAll("#reg-table th").forEach((th) =>
      th.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const k = th.dataset.k;
        sortState = { key: k, dir: sortState.key === k ? -sortState.dir : 1 };
        renderTable(currentRows);
      })
    );
  }

  function rebuildChildSelect(sel, key, filter) {
    const values = uniq(all.filter(filter), key);
    sel.innerHTML = `<option value="">All ${key === "district" ? "districts" : "wards"}</option>`;
    for (const v of values) sel.add(new Option(v, v));
    sel.disabled = values.length === 0;
  }

  function applyFilters() {
    const q = els.fSearch.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    currentRows = all.filter((r) => {
      if (els.fRegion.value   && r.region   !== els.fRegion.value)   return false;
      if (els.fDistrict.value && r.district !== els.fDistrict.value) return false;
      if (els.fWard.value     && r.ward     !== els.fWard.value)     return false;
      if (els.fBiz.value && r.business_type !== els.fBiz.value) return false;
      if (els.fAcc.value && r.accreditation_source !== els.fAcc.value) return false;
      if (q) {
        const hay = [r.addo_name, r.district, r.ward, r.village_street].join(" ").toLowerCase();
        if (!hay.includes(q)) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
    renderSummary(currentRows);
    renderMap();  // uses currentView + currentRows
    renderTable(currentRows);
    renderCharts(currentRows);
  }

  // ── Summary cards ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function renderSummary(rows) {
    const geocoded = rows.filter((r) => r.has_coords).length;
    const regions   = new Set(rows.map((r) => r.region).filter(Boolean)).size;
    const districts = new Set(rows.map((r) => r.district).filter(Boolean)).size;
    els.summary.innerHTML = `
      <div class="reg-scard"><div class="val">${rows.length.toLocaleString()}</div><div class="lbl">Outlets in view</div></div>
      <div class="reg-scard"><div class="val">${geocoded.toLocaleString()}</div><div class="lbl">With GPS (${rows.length ? Math.round((100 * geocoded) / rows.length) : 0}%)</div></div>
      <div class="reg-scard"><div class="val">${regions}</div><div class="lbl">Regions</div></div>
      <div class="reg-scard"><div class="val">${districts}</div><div class="lbl">Districts</div></div>`;
  }

  // ── Map: view switcher ───────────────────────────────────────────
  function setView(view) {
    currentView = view;
    els.viewPills.forEach(b => b.classList.toggle("active", b.dataset.view === view));
    renderMap();
  }

  function renderMap() {
    if (polyLayer) { map.removeLayer(polyLayer); polyLayer = null; }
    map.removeControl(legendCtl); map.removeControl(hoverCtl);
    renderChoropleth(currentView);
  }

  async function loadGeo(level) {
    if (geoCache[level]) return geoCache[level];
    els.viewNote.textContent = `Loading ${level} boundaries…`;
    const res = await fetch(GEO_URLS[level]);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Failed to load ${level}: ${res.status}`);
    const gj = await res.json();
    geoCache[level] = gj;
    return gj;
  }

  async function renderChoropleth(level) {
    let gj;
    try { gj = await loadGeo(level); }
    catch (e) {
      els.viewNote.textContent = e.message;
      els.viewNote.style.color = "#dc2626";
      return;
    }

    // Recompute counts from currentRows so filters flow into the choropleth.
    const gidKey = GID_COL[level];
    const counts = {};
    let unmatched = 0;
    for (const r of currentRows) {
      const g = r[gidKey];
      if (g) counts[g] = (counts[g] || 0) + 1;
      else unmatched += 1;
    }

    const values = gj.features.map(f => counts[f.properties.gid] || 0);
    const breaks = computeBreaks(values);

    polyLayer = L.geoJSON(gj, {
      style: (f) => ({
        fillColor: colorFor(counts[f.properties.gid] || 0, breaks),
        weight: level === "wards" ? 0.3 : 0.7,
        opacity: 1,
        color: "#ffffff",
        fillOpacity: 0.85,
      }),
      onEachFeature: (feature, layer) => {
        const p = { ...feature.properties, addo_count: counts[feature.properties.gid] || 0 };
        layer.on({
          mouseover: (e) => {
            e.target.setStyle({ weight: 2, color: "#0f172a" });
            e.target.bringToFront();
            hoverCtl.update(p);
          },
          mouseout: (e) => {
            polyLayer.resetStyle(e.target);
            hoverCtl.update(null);
          },
          click: (e) => {
            map.fitBounds(e.target.getBounds(), { padding: [20, 20] });
            L.popup()
              .setLatLng(e.latlng)
              .setContent(
                `<strong>${escapeHtml(p.name)}</strong><br/>` +
                (p.district ? `${escapeHtml(p.district)}, ` : "") +
                (p.region ? `${escapeHtml(p.region)}<br/>` : "") +
                `<strong style="color:#0d9488">${(p.addo_count).toLocaleString()}</strong> CPPs`
              ).openOn(map);
          },
        });
      },
    }).addTo(map);

    legendCtl.addTo(map);
    hoverCtl.addTo(map);
    legendCtl.update(breaks, level.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + level.slice(1, -1));

    // Fit to the filtered subset when a filter zooms us to a region/district
    if (els.fRegion.value || els.fDistrict.value) {
      map.fitBounds(polyLayer.getBounds(), { padding: [20, 20], maxZoom: 10 });
    } else {
      map.setView([-6.4, 35.0], 6);
    }

    const matched = currentRows.length - unmatched;
    const pct = currentRows.length ? Math.round(100 * matched / currentRows.length) : 0;
    els.viewNote.style.color = "#64748b";
    els.viewNote.textContent =
      `${matched.toLocaleString()} / ${currentRows.length.toLocaleString()} outlets placed in ${level} polygons (${pct}%). ` +
      `${unmatched.toLocaleString()} could not be auto-matched.`;
  }

  // ── Table ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function renderTable(rows) {
    const { key, dir } = sortState;
    const sorted = [...rows].sort((a, b) => dir * cmp(a[key], b[key]));
    const first = sorted.slice(0, 500);
    els.tbody.innerHTML = first.map((r) => `
      <tr>
        <td>${fmt(r.addo_name)}</td>
        <td>${fmt(r.business_type)}</td>
        <td>${fmt(r.accreditation_source)}</td>
        <td>${fmt(r.region)}</td>
        <td>${fmt(r.district)}</td>
        <td>${fmt(r.ward)}</td>
        <td>${r.has_coords ? "&#10003;" : "&mdash;"}</td>
      </tr>`).join("");
    if (rows.length > 500) {
      els.tbody.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend",
        `<tr><td colspan="7" style="text-align:center;font-style:italic;color:#64748b;padding:.75rem;">Showing first 500 of ${rows.length.toLocaleString()} outlets &mdash; narrow the filters to see more, or download the CSV.</td></tr>`);
    }
  }

  // ── Charts ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function tally(rows, k, top) {
    const counts = {};
    for (const r of rows) {
      const v = r[k] || "Unknown";
      counts[v] = (counts[v] || 0) + 1;
    }
    const entries = Object.entries(counts).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
    return top ? entries.slice(0, top) : entries;
  }
  function renderCharts(rows) {
    const regions = tally(rows, "region", 15);
    const acc = tally(rows, "accreditation_source");
    if (regionChart.instance) regionChart.instance.destroy();
    if (accChart.instance) accChart.instance.destroy();
    regionChart.instance = new Chart(document.getElementById("chart-region"), {
      type: "bar",
      data: { labels: regions.map(e => e[0]), datasets: [{ data: regions.map(e => e[1]), backgroundColor: "#0d9488" }] },
      options: { indexAxis: "y", responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false,
        plugins: { legend: { display: false } }, scales: { x: { beginAtZero: true } } },
    });
    accChart.instance = new Chart(document.getElementById("chart-acc"), {
      type: "doughnut",
      data: { labels: acc.map(e => e[0]), datasets: [{ data: acc.map(e => e[1]),
        backgroundColor: ["#0d9488", "#0f172a", "#64748b", "#f59e0b"] }] },
      options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { position: "bottom" } } },
    });
  }
})();
</script>
```
